title.en: Creating a Committee to Assess the Competence and Performance of Career Service Officers and Other Officers in the Civil Service
title.orig: Creating a Committee to Assess the Competence and Performance of Career Service Officers and Other Officers in the Civil Service

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation
source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00716_1981_html.txt

text.en:
The Committee may call upon the Career Executive Service Board and the Civil Service Commission
or any officer or employee thereof to serve as its secretariat.

The assessment made by the Committee shall confidential and shall be submitted to the Office of the
President to aid the Office in the selection and appointment of officers. The report may, however, be made
available to the ministry and other office heads concerned.

The Committee may call upon any officers to constitute a panel of experts to help in its evaluation of
the competence and performance of government officers.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 6th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
